name: Campfire
description: Campfire is a self-hosted group chat from 37signals with rooms and access controls, direct messages, @mentions, search and file attachments with previews. Bots can join conversations through its API and webhooks.

notes.text: Open http://<IP> and create the admin account in the setup wizard; its email address is shown on the sign-in page as the contact for help.
Web Push notifications only work over HTTPS with a trusted certificate, so put Campfire behind a reverse proxy if you want them.
